Day 4:
Lower Body:
A1. Frog Hold x 30s hold x 3 sets, rest 30s
*light contraction into the floor
A2. Elevated Pigeon Stretch x 20-30s hold per side x 3 sets, rest 90s

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1x_x97fRJiY
*pigeon
+
B. Depth Drop + Light Tier Double Leg Leap: 3 x 3-5 reps by singles, rest 1-2 minutes.
*20" box
**You'll step off the box, hit the floor, and small rebound off the ground, then settle into your "athletic" stance.

C. Skater Bound (rebound): 4 x 5-7 reps per side, rest 90s.
*Let's work on some rebounding reps, start with a small distance and be smooth. You don't have to be exploisve yet or try for a large effort. We can build here.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aJzKiPxRFAE

D. Sled Push into Small "Sprint": 3-5 sets x 10-20ft. sled push + 10-20ft. "sprint", rest as needed to keep quality high.
*30-35# on the sled. Focus is still moving with speed/higher effort. Don't let the initial weight be a deterrent

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VwXUkAJPmy8
